source: メガトン第 7 居住甲板 (src/world/megaton.js) の改修用。画像が無いあいだは既存の素材に色を付けて代用している。自分で作った 3x3 の画像を assets/textures/sheets/<id>.webp に置くか、texgen.py generate で生成する
style: Public facilities of a space-habitat neighbourhood: school, clinic, bathhouse, library and a small shrine. Each cell is ONE surface or item, front-on or top-down, flat even light, no shadows, no readable text.

cells.name: mg-blackboard
cells.prompt: A school blackboard with chalk drawings of planets, orbits and simple diagrams, no words.

cells.name: mg-counter
cells.prompt: The front of a ward office service counter: white panels with a number display slot (blank) and a small step.

cells.name: mg-hospital-curtain
cells.prompt: Hospital privacy curtain fabric: pale mint green with soft folds, front-on.

cells.name: mg-clinic-floor
cells.prompt: Clinic floor from above: white sheet vinyl with a faint grey fleck, very clean.

cells.name: mg-gym-floor
cells.prompt: School gym floor from above: light maple boards with painted court lines in blue and red.

cells.name: mg-bath-mural
cells.prompt: A public bathhouse mural: a big ringed gas-giant planet rising over a sea of golden clouds, painted in a classic bathhouse style.

cells.name: mg-bath-tile
cells.prompt: Public bath tiles: small white and pale blue square tiles in a simple pattern, glossy, front-on.

cells.name: mg-library-shelf
cells.prompt: A library bookshelf front packed with books of many colours, neat rows, no readable titles.

cells.name: mg-shrine
cells.prompt: The front of a small wooden Shinto shrine (hokora): little lattice doors, a straw rope with white paper streamers, offerings.
